CIT001.name: Campus Main Gate
CIT001.notes: Main campus entrance on Avinashi Road near Civil Aerodrome post.

CIT002.name: Main Building / Main Block
CIT002.notes: Historic administrative block housing the Principal office and central administration.

CIT003.name: Library Block
CIT003.notes: Central multi-floor library located immediately west of the Main Building.

CIT004.name: Computing Block
CIT004.notes: Houses Department of Computing and M.Sc. software laboratories.

CIT005.name: IT Block
CIT005.notes: Dedicated Information Technology academic and laboratory building.

CIT006.name: CIT Auditorium
CIT006.notes: Primary institutional auditorium for cultural symposiums and major gatherings.

CIT007.name: MSc/MBA Block
CIT007.notes: Postgraduate block for Master of Business Administration and integrated courses.

CIT008.name: Mechanical & Civil Engineering Block
CIT008.notes: Core engineering block housing Civil and Mechanical engineering laboratories.
